Title: EULAR recommendations for intra-articular therapies
Abstract: The best <m>approach</m> for a certain joint cannot be recommended except for the <m>knee</m> in which an SR showed that the <m>superolateral</m> <m>approach</m> was more common and resulted in the highest pooled <m>accuracy</m> rate of 91% (95% CI 84% to 99%) in @SPECIES_9606 @@@patients@@@ with different arthropathies.
